title: Microtato
description: Casting spells, running away from monsters and building tiny castles, at least there are no scary machines to hunt you.
body:
### Casting spells, running away from monsters and building very tiny castles. 
Sounds good to you? Then I have a small modpack for you. 
Centered around LittleTiles, Microtato is build for casual players that want a little more variety in the mobs that make them respawn. 

Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks and Born in Chaos populate your world with towers, dungeons, magic creatures and your corpse. 
After retrieving your stuff, you get back to your base detailed with LittleTiles to eat a stew from Caupona or a full fetched meal from Farmers Delight. Repeat until you become the greatest Magician.

The pack is deliberately kept small to make it easier for casual and first time players.
Microtato is made for a small personal project of mine, don't expect minor bug fixes or updates as I don't have the time to maintain the project in the long run.
